description: Focused Ralph PRD for repairing the current branch's GitHub CI failure before adding any broader OSv2 capability work.

userStories.title: Repair RLS Race Coverage Performance Gate
userStories.story: As a backend maintainer, I want the CEL row-level-security performance gate to stay strict in normal runs while tolerating race and coverage instrumentation variance, so GitHub CI blocks real hot-path regressions without failing from runner contention.

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Instrumented profile avoids CI wall-clock flake
acceptanceCriteria.given: Go tests run with race detection or coverage instrumentation enabled
acceptanceCriteria.when: the RLS performance profile is selected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the profile uses a smaller instrumented iteration count and budgets that match race/coverage overhead while still exercising warm-cache hits

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Focused race and coverage RLS gate passes
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pkg/security RLS performance tests run with `-race -covermode=atomic`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the selected profile is `instrumented`, cache hit stats are logged, and the test exits successfully

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: Full pkg/security race coverage gate passes
acceptanceCriteria.given: the same package shape used by GitHub CI is executed for pkg/security
pkg/security tests run without race or coverage instrumentation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the selected profile remains `standard` with one-million-iteration warm-cache samples, keeps the 50ms strict budget, and uses the best of three warm samples to smooth scheduler jitter without hiding real regressions
